wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 05-004 wires the title-loop, menu, HUD font, status-bar, intermission, finale, and ENDOOM patch lumps into a single frozen runtime artifact. The new wrapper at src/vanilla/uiPatchAssets.ts imports the read-only resolveUiAssetLumps helper from src/ui/assets.ts (which already enumerates every shareware-safe UI patch by name) and adds a dedicated ENDOOM lookup via IwadResourceCache.findLump. The wrapper performs no filesystem I/O and never throws; missing lumps surface via UiAssetCatalog.missing and missing ENDOOM surfaces via endoomPresent=false, matching the vanilla graceful-degradation pattern.
